candidate_lesson.lesson_text: When the 30-indicator consensus reports conv=100% but green_matches ≥ 3 with hist_hr ~68%, only take the signal if there is at least one green historical match; conv=100% with green_matches=0 (like EURUSD/USDJPY today) is untested conviction and should be sized at zero.
candidate_lesson.mechanism: Conviction measures live indicator agreement, but hist_hr and green_matches measure whether that exact fingerprint has ever paid out. High live agreement with no historical analogue means the setup is novel — novelty in systematic macro is unpriced risk, not edge. Institutions crowd into repeatable patterns; a pattern with zero prior matches has no crowd behind it to complete the move.
candidate_lesson.testable_rule: if consensus.conv >= 0.90 and consensus.green_matches == 0: size = 0  # require green_matches >= 1 and hist_hr >= 0.60 to trade a high-conviction signal
candidate_lesson.expected_impact: Filters false-positive high-conviction entries (EURUSD conv=58%/hr=0%, USDJPY conv=42%/hr=0% today would be blocked); expected win-rate lift by removing untested setups, contributing toward +0.02-0.03 Sharpe by cutting variance-heavy losers.
candidate_lesson.evidence_from_harvest: Live consensus shows GBPUSD (conv=100%, green_matches=5, hist_hr=68%) and AUDUSD (conv=100%, green_matches=3, hist_hr=68%) as historically validated, while EURUSD/USDJPY/AUDNZD show conv with green_matches=0 and hist_hr=0% — the divergence isolates conviction from historical payoff.
